responsibility: Implements lowering of nested functions to an explicit static-chain and nonlocal-frame representation in GIMPLE. It records nested-function relationships in the callgraph, builds per-function nesting summaries, rewrites nonlocal variable and goto references into accesses through synthesized frame structures, adjusts calls and local/debug declarations, finalizes transformed bodies, and updates cgraph nesting so formerly nested functions become ordinary standalone functions for later optimization and code generation.
same_name_distinction: Performs the nested-function lowering transformation itself: builds nesting summaries, rewrites nonlocal references and calls, creates frame/static-chain accesses, finalizes rewritten bodies, and unnests cgraph nodes. Unlike gcc/tree-nested.h, this file contains the lowering pass implementation.
